links.comparator_used: Conventional cloud-based DLP proxy gateways (server-side intermediate processing), rather than sending full identified records
links.outcome: Processing latency of de-identification before transmission to AI APIs, with recall of HIPAA identifiers and outbound PHI bytes
links.effect: Client-side ZTDS: 99.94% recall on direct HIPAA 18 identifiers, average 1.84 ms per note vs 242.6 ms for cloud DLP proxy gateways (131-fold latency reduction); zero outbound bytes of PHI on packet inspection in connected and Airplane Mode states (2,500 synthetic notes)
links.quote: In comparison, conventional cloud-based DLP proxy gatewaysincurred an average latency of 242.6 ms (a 131-fold latency reduction)

design_hint: client-side de-identification before sending text to LLM APIs
